$comment: Starter golden dataset for `recallum-admin eval`. Grow it with real queries your agents got wrong: every regression you fix should leave a query behind. Tags name the retrieval class a query exercises so tuning changes show per-class effects.

corpus.content: Prefer pnpm over npm for JavaScript package installs
The database of record is PostgreSQL 17 with pgvector
Deploys go through Dokploy on the VPS, never manual docker commands
Run unit tests with uv run pytest tests/unit before pushing
Ruff is the only linter and formatter, line length 100
All timestamps are stored timezone-aware in UTC
Los respaldos de la base de datos corren cada noche a las 02:00
La documentación de usuario se escribe en español
API keys are stored only as SHA-256 hashes, never plaintext
SessionProvider.for_user opens an RLS-scoped transaction per call
Embeddings come from local Ollama running embeddinggemma 300m

queries.query: which package manager should I use
en qué idioma va la documentación
